The Denali Reserve Package elevates your ownership experience with distinctive 22-inch Pearl Nickel machined aluminum wheels wrapped in all-season tires, complemented by a performance suspension system engineered for improved handling. The Super Cruise system, Enhanced Automatic Parking Assist, and Driver Attention Assist work together to make your drives more manageable on a daily basis. The 15-inch diagonal premium GMC infotainment system supports Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, keeping you connected to your digital life. SiriusXM with 360L satellite radio ensures entertainment options during every journey, while the heads-up display projects essential driving information directly onto your windshield.

Convenience features include remote keyless entry, automatic temperature control with front dual-zone and rear air conditioning, power windows, power door mirrors with heating, and a power liftgate that simplifies cargo loading. The auto-dimming rear-view mirror and automatic high-beam headlights with delay-off functionality add practical touches to your daily driving routine.

Safety is addressed through comprehensive standard features including electronic stability control, traction control, four-wheel independent suspension, and multiple airbag systems including dual front impact, side impact, and overhead airbags. The exterior rear camera provides visibility assistance when backing up or parking.

The 2021 Chevrolet Tahoe Z71 is engineered for capability and comfort. Its EcoTec3 5.3L V8 engine paired with a 10-speed automatic transmission delivers responsive performance. The 4WD system and 2-Speed Active Electronic AutoTrac Transfer Case provide confidence on varied terrain, while Hill Descent Control enhances control on steep grades. You'll appreciate the fuel efficiency at 15 city and 20 highway MPG for a full-size SUV of this caliber.

Inside, the spacious three-row cabin prioritizes passenger comfort and connectivity. Second-row bucket seats offer flexibility, while heated leather seating in the front creates a premium driving environment. Memory settings for the driver seat and steering wheel personalize your experience. The Chevrolet Infotainment 3 Plus system with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto keeps you connected, while the Bose 9-speaker audio system delivers quality sound throughout the cabin.

Practical features enhance daily convenience. The power liftgate with hands-free operation simplifies cargo management, and the floor console with storage provides organization options. OnStar emergency communication and Chevrolet Connected Services offer peace of mind on every journey. Rain-sensing wipers, auto high-beam headlights, and speed-sensing power steering add refinement to the driving experience.

The Z71 package combines rugged capability with refined comfort. Black tubular assist steps provide easy entry and exit, while bright door sill plates add visual definition. The front high-approach angle fascia improves off-road geometry, backed by four-wheel independent suspension engineered for smooth highway performance and trail readiness. Electronic Stability Control and traction control work continuously to maintain stability in challenging conditions.

Safety is paramount in this Tahoe. The vehicle features dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, front and rear anti-roll bars, and occupant-sensing technology. Four-wheel independent suspension combines with four-wheel disc brakes and ABS for responsive stopping power. The comprehensive airbag system protects occupants throughout the cabin.

description: REFINED, CAPABLE, ONE-OWNER, OFF-LEASE, NONSMOKER, FIRST-CLASS FAMILY ADVENTURES AWAIT! The 2023 Ford Expedition Max Platinum is one of the most luxurious and capable full-size SUVs on the road today. Its extended-wheelbase design provides exceptional passenger comfort and an enormous cargo area without compromising the confident performance and refinement expected from Ford's flagship SUV. Equipped with an intelligent FOUR-WHEEL DRIVE system, this Expedition Max is ready for changing weather, towing duties, family vacations, and everyday commuting alike. Whether navigating snowy roads or heading out on a cross-country adventure, it delivers the confidence and capability buyers expect from a premium full-size SUV. WHY SHOPPERS BUY THIS MODEL The Expedition Max has become a favorite among families who need genuine full-size capability without stepping into a heavy-duty SUV. Buyers appreciate its spacious three-row interior, outstanding towing capability, smooth ride quality, and flexible cargo space that comfortably accommodates passengers and luggage at the same time. The extended Max model is especially desirable because it offers substantially more cargo room behind the third row than the standard Expedition, making it ideal for growing families, long vacations, youth sports, and anyone who regularly travels with people and gear. It combines the practicality of a large SUV with refinement that rivals many luxury competitors. AUTOMOTIVE PRESS AND INDUSTRY RECOGNITION The Expedition has earned consistent praise from automotive journalists for its impressive towing capability, spacious interior, powerful EcoBoost engine, comfortable ride, and advanced technology. The Platinum trim has been especially recognized for offering luxury-level comfort while retaining the utility expected from a traditional body-on-frame SUV. IIHS Top Safety Pick recipient for appropriately equipped Expedition models. Consistently recognized among the top full-size SUVs for passenger comfort and towing capability. Praised for interior technology, cargo versatility, and strong twin-turbocharged EcoBoost performance. WARRANTY The odometer is hovering around the 44,058-mile mark, and it is STILL COVERED by the factory. Remaining Transferable Factory Coverage Ford New Vehicle Limited Warranty -- Comprehensive factory coverage remains in effect until 08/01/2026 or 36,000 miles, whichever comes first. This coverage has expired due to mileage. Ford Powertrain Limited Warranty -- Coverage for the engine, transmission, and drivetrain remains in effect until 08/01/2028 or 60,000 miles, whichever comes first. Corrosion Perforation Warranty -- Coverage remains in effect until 08/01/2028 with unlimited mileage. Extended service plans may also be available to provide additional peace of mind throughout your ownership experience. STANDARD FEATURES The Platinum trim sits at the top of the Expedition lineup, surrounding every journey with premium comfort, advanced technology, and exceptional craftsmanship. Standard equipment includes luxurious leather seating, heated and ventilated front seats, massaging front seats, a panoramic Vista Roof, a premium Bang & Olufsen sound system, BlueCruise capability, a large touchscreen infotainment system, power-folding third-row seating, and numerous advanced driver-assistance technologies that make long trips remarkably relaxing. INSTALLED OPTIONS This Expedition Max was exceptionally well equipped from the factory with premium appearance, convenience, and towing upgrades. Equipment Group 600A Platinum Series luxury equipment. Panoramic Vista Roof. Tri-zone electronic climate control. Bang & Olufsen Unleashed premium audio system. Reverse Sensing System. Connected Navigation capability. Remote Start System. Heated and ventilated front seats. Heated second-row seats. PowerFold third-row seating. Advanced Cargo Manager. Heavy-Duty Trailer Tow Package Enhanced towing capability. Integrated trailer brake controller. Pro Trailer Backup Assist. Additional towing equipment for greater confidence when hauling larger trailers. Standalone Features Agate Black Metallic premium exterior paint. 22'' polished aluminum wheels. Black roof-rail crossbars. Second-row window one-touch operation. TRUCK CAPABILITY The Expedition Max is built on Ford's rugged body-on-frame architecture, giving it the strength to confidently handle everything from family road trips to serious towing responsibilities. Its extended wheelbase enhances cargo capacity while maintaining the impressive capability expected from Ford's flagship full-size SUV. 3.5-liter EcoBoost twin-turbocharged V6. 10-speed SelectShift automatic transmission. Intelligent FOUR-WHEEL DRIVE system. Heavy-Duty Trailer Tow Package. Integrated Trailer Brake Controller. Pro Trailer Backup Assist. Pro Trailer Hitch Assist. Trailer Sway Control. Towing When properly equipped as this Expedition Max Platinum is, Ford rates maximum conventional towing at up to 9,000 pounds, making it an excellent choice for towing travel trailers, boats, campers, and enclosed utility trailers. Payload Properly configured examples typically provide payload capacity of approximately 1,650 pounds, offering ample capability for passengers, luggage, and cargo. Cargo Area The Expedition Max's extended body provides one of the largest cargo areas in its class, with generous space behind the third-row seat and expansive storage when the rear seats are folded. Power-folding second- and third-row seating makes transitioning between passenger and cargo duty quick and effortless. MECHANICAL FEATURES Ford's proven 3.5-liter EcoBoost twin-turbocharged V6 delivers an impressive 400 horsepower and 480 lb-ft of torque, providing smooth acceleration, confident passing power, and outstanding towing capability. Paired with the responsive 10-speed automatic transmission, it balances strong performance with refined highway cruising. 3.5-liter EcoBoost twin-turbocharged V6. 10-speed SelectShift automatic transmission. Intelligent FOUR-WHEEL DRIVE. Independent front and rear suspension. Adaptive suspension with Continuous Controlled Damping. Electric power-assisted steering. Terrain Management System. Hill Descent Control. Four-wheel disc brakes. Despite its impressive size, the Expedition Max feels remarkably composed on the highway thanks to refined suspension tuning, responsive steering, and a quiet cabin that makes long-distance travel relaxing for everyone on board. EXTERIOR FEATURES The Platinum trim combines bold styling with premium finishes to create an SUV that's equally at home pulling up to a luxury resort or heading toward the mountains with the family. Agate Black Metallic premium exterior paint. Panoramic Vista Roof. 22'' polished aluminum wheels. LED reflector headlamps. LED fog lamps. Power-deployable running boards. Hands-free power liftgate. Black roof-rail crossbars. Heated, power-folding mirrors. Rain-sensing windshield wipers. Its long, confident profile isn't simply about appearance ... the Max wheelbase creates exceptional cargo capacity while preserving elegant proportions and commanding road presence. INTERIOR FEATURES The Platinum cabin surrounds every passenger with premium materials and thoughtful comfort features designed for long-distance travel. Carmelo leather-trimmed seating. Heated and ventilated front seats. Active Motion massaging front seats. Heated second-row seats. Power-folding second-row captain's chairs. PowerFold third-row seating. Tri-zone automatic climate control. Heated steering wheel. Wireless charging pad. Advanced Cargo Manager. Whether you're carrying seven passengers or loading up for a family vacation, the Expedition Max delivers the comfort, flexibility, and refinement expected from Ford's flagship SUV. Discover the 2023 Land Rover Defender 130 X-Dynamic SE, a versatile SUV that combines rugged capability with premium comfort. With just over 48,361 miles, this used model boasts a striking white exterior and a sophisticated beige interior, offering a refined yet adventurous driving experience. Powered by a 3.0-liter gasoline engine with electric-assisted turbocharging, it delivers 395 horsepower and 406 lb-ft of torque, making it perfect for off-road excursions or daily commutes. The 8-speed ZF automatic transmission and all-wheel drive system ensure smooth handling and stability on any terrain. Inside, occupants enjoy amenities such as heated and cooled leather seats, a sunroof, third-row seating, and a Wi-Fi hotspot, all complemented by advanced tech features like Apple CarPlay, Bluetooth, navigation, and a premium 14-speaker audio system with surround sound. 2023 Land Rover Defender Safety and Security Features

The Defender's safety package prioritizes occupant security with a vehicle exit safety system and traffic sign recognition that adjusts speed accordingly. Front and rear parking sensors assist with precise maneuvering, while regenerative braking improves energy efficiency. Four-wheel ABS, emergency braking prep, and cornering brake control enhance stopping power and stability. Auto-locking power door locks and anti-lockout features add an extra layer of security, ensuring peace of mind during every drive.

2023 Land Rover Defender Entertainment and Technology Features

The Defender offers a high-tech interior centered around an 11.4-inch touchscreen infotainment system with HD radio and surround sound, supported by 14 speakers for immersive listening. Smart device app compatibility with InControl allows remote engine start and cabin preconditioning, enhancing convenience. Voice-operated hands-free calling and radio functions, along with a premium 700-watt amplifier, ensure connectivity and entertainment are always within reach, whether on daily commutes or off-road adventures.

2023 Land Rover Defender Performance Features

Performance is a priority with the Defender’s active and air suspension systems, providing smooth rides over rough terrain. Electronic suspension control and driver-adjustable ride and height settings allow customization for comfort or handling. The lithium-ion battery powers a capable electric assist, while an electronic hi-lo 4WD selector and self-leveling suspension enhance off-road capability. A center locking differential further improves traction, making this SUV ready for any challenge on or off the beaten path.

The 2023 Chevrolet Tahoe RST stands as a capable full-size SUV ready to handle both daily driving and weekend adventures with confident performance and refined comfort.

- 6.2L EcoTec3 V8 engine with 420 hp and 460 lb-ft of torque
- RST Performance Edition with high-performance suspension package

- Cat-Back Performance Exhaust with dual twin polished stainless-steel tips

The aggressive 20-inch wheels and distinctive black nameplates contribute to its commanding presence on the road.

Inside, the cabin reflects a thoughtful approach to comfort and convenience. The leather-appointed seats feature both heating and power adjustment, allowing occupants to customize their driving experience. The Chevrolet Infotainment 3 Premium system integrates seamlessly with your smartphone through Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, keeping you connected without distraction.

The interior design prioritizes functionality alongside comfort. Three rows of seating accommodate larger families or provide additional cargo space when needed. The power-folding third-row seats fold flush with the cargo floor, expanding versatility for hauling larger items. Wireless charging keeps your devices ready, while the HD Surround Vision camera system enhances awareness when maneuvering in tight spaces.

Safety receives equal attention, with features like Enhanced Automatic Emergency Braking, Rear Cross Traffic Alert, and Rear Pedestrian Alert working together to help protect you and your passengers. The four-wheel independent suspension maintains stability, while traction control and electronic stability control support confident driving in varying conditions.

The 4WD system ensures you maintain traction when conditions demand it, whether on wet pavement or light off-road terrain. This Tahoe is built to go where you need it to go, carrying what you need to carry, and do it with the confidence that comes from proven engineering and genuine capability.

This 2022 BMW X7 xDrive40i represents a sophisticated choice for drivers who value luxury, capability, and refined engineering in their three-row SUV.

- Remote Engine Start
- Driving Assistance Professional Package with ACC, stop and go, active lane keeping, steering and traffic jam assistant, automatic lane change, and cross-traffic alert
- M Sport Package with aerodynamic kit, M steering wheel, and exclusive styling
- Parking Assistance Package including drive recorder, surround view with 3D view, and parking assistant plus
- Premium Package with gesture control, rear electric side window shades, soft-close automatic doors, and head-up display
- Extended Shadowline Trim
- 22" bi-color wheels with performance run-flat tires
- Cognac Vernasca leather upholstery
- Panoramic power moonroof
- Heated and power front sport seats
- Live Cockpit Pro with navigation
- SiriusXM 360L satellite radio with wireless charging
- Three-row seating with reclining third row
- Extended traffic jam assistant and active driving assistant pro

The X7 combines luxury with practical functionality. Its 3.0L turbocharged inline-six engine paired with an 8-speed automatic transmission and all-wheel drive delivers balanced performance, achieving 19 mpg city and 24 mpg highway. The sophisticated Tanzanite Blue II metallic exterior finish complements the premium Cognac leather interior, creating an inviting atmosphere for all passengers.

Advanced technology systems enhance both safety and convenience. The driving assistance suite provides comprehensive support during various driving conditions, while the parking assistance package offers multiple viewing angles and automated parking functions. Gesture control allows intuitive interaction with vehicle systems, and the head-up display keeps critical information visible without requiring downward glances.

Comfort features throughout the cabin reflect careful attention to occupant experience. Heated and cooled front seats, heated armrests, and heated steering wheel ensure comfort across seasons. Automatic climate control zones for front and rear passengers, along with rear window defroster, maintain optimal temperatures throughout the vehicle. Soft-close doors and power-adjustable memory seats personalize the driving environment.

The X7 accommodates up to seven passengers with three distinct seating rows. Split-folding rear seats and a reclining third row offer flexibility for both passengers and cargo. The panoramic moonroof floods the interior with natural light, enhancing the sense of space and openness.

This BMW X7 xDrive40i combines premium materials, advanced technology, and thoughtful design to deliver genuine value for those seeking a luxury three-row SUV. We invite you to schedule a test drive and experience this vehicle's capabilities and refinement firsthand.

The 2022 BMW X4 M40i stands out as a luxury SUV that blends performance, style, and advanced technology. With a sleek Brooklyn Grey Metallic exterior and a rich Tacora Red interior, this used vehicle offers a bold presence on the road. Powered by a 3.0-liter turbocharged six-cylinder engine producing 382 horsepower at 5800 rpm and 369 lb-ft of torque at 1800 rpm, it delivers exhilarating acceleration and smooth handling. The all-wheel-drive system ensures confident traction across diverse driving conditions, while the 30,186 miles indicate a well-maintained, lightly used vehicle. Its sporty yet refined design features a four-door layout and seating for five, making it perfect for both daily commutes and weekend adventures. The X4 M40i is packed with modern amenities, including Apple CarPlay, a backup camera, blind spot monitor, Bluetooth connectivity, collision warning, cross traffic alert, and a hands-free liftgate. Additional features like keyless entry, memory seats, built-in navigation, push start, satellite radio readiness, a sunroof/moonroof, and a wifi hotspot elevate your driving experience, combining convenience with luxury. The 2022 BMW X4 Safety and Security Features This SUV prioritizes safety with dual front knee airbags and traffic sign recognition that help keep occupants protected and aware on the road. Premium brakes, front and rear parking sensors, a regenerative braking system, 4-wheel ABS, emergency braking preparation, cornering brake control, and auto-locking power door locks work together to enhance control and security. These features ensure peace of mind whether navigating city streets or highway driving, making this vehicle a reliable choice for safety-conscious drivers. The 2022 BMW X4 Entertainment and Technology Features Equipped with a 12.3-inch infotainment screen, the X4 offers intuitive access to entertainment and information. BMW ConnectedDrive compatibility allows you to control smart device apps, including using your phone as a key, while the 12 speakers deliver rich sound throughout the cabin. Voice-operated hands-free phone calls and radio, HD radio, and a touchscreen display make media control effortless. Real-time traffic updates in the navigation system and voice-operated electronic messaging enhance connectivity, keeping you informed and entertained during every journey. The 2022 BMW X4 Performance Features This model features an active suspension system that adapts to driving conditions for optimal comfort and agility. Auto start/stop technology conserves fuel, while electronic suspension control and driver-adjustable ride control allow customization of driving dynamics. The suspension is tuned for sport, providing a balanced mix of comfort and performance. With full-time four-wheel drive, the X4 M40i delivers superior stability and capability, whether on winding roads or rough terrain, ensuring a dynamic and responsive driving experience.

              Safety and Security
              • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
              • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
              • Hands-on cruise control. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with hands-on cruise control, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles. It slows you down, speeds you up and even keeps you in your own lane. Meet your ultimate co-pilot with hands-on cruise control.
              Technology and Telematics
              • Smart device mirroring - Smartphone, meet smart car. You can control your device through your vehicle's infotainment system. Smart device mirroring brings together safety and convenience by making it easier to find what you're looking for while keeping your eyes on the road.
              • Mobile hotspot - WiFi on the fly. Connect your devices to the Internet through your vehicle's private mobile hotspot and take the internet wherever your journey takes you, without eating up your data allowance. Find the hotspot with mobile hotspot.

description:
This 2022 Lexus GX 460 delivers capable performance and refined comfort for those seeking a three-row luxury SUV with genuine all-terrain capability and premium appointments.

- 4.6L V8 DOHC Dual VVT-i engine with 6-speed automatic transmission and 4WD
- Premium Plus Package with Captain's Chairs and wood trim accents
- Mark Levinson Surround Sound System with 17 speakers and 330 watts
- Ventilated front seats with front and rear heating
- Dual front and rear automatic air conditioning
- 3rd row power seats for convenient access and configuration
- LED front fog and driving lamps
- Navigation system with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility
- Power moonroof
- Heated wood and leather steering wheel
- Cargo-area tonneau cover with dedicated cargo net
- All-weather floor liners and premium paint
- Comprehensive safety features including nine airbags and Safety Connect

The exterior showcases a striking white premium paint finish complemented by 18-inch dark gray metallic aluminum alloy wheels. Headlamp washers and LED fog lamps enhance visibility in varied conditions, while illuminated running boards and practical roof rack rails demonstrate thoughtful design for both aesthetics and function.

Step inside to find a sophisticated cabin built for long journeys. The Premium Plus Package elevates the driving experience with wood trim on the upper portion of doors, ventilated front seats, and a windshield deicer for year-round convenience. Captain's chairs in the second row provide individual comfort and ease of access to the third row, which features power seat adjustment for maximum flexibility.

Climate control benefits from dual front and rear automatic air conditioning zones, ensuring all passengers remain comfortable regardless of exterior temperatures. The Lexus Multimedia System provides intuitive interface to your smartphone through Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, keeping you connected to navigation, messaging, and entertainment throughout your drive.

Safety remains paramount with this GX, equipped with electronic stability control, traction control, auto high-beam headlights, and a comprehensive airbag system spanning front, side, and overhead positions. The anti-whiplash front head restraints and rear side impact airbags provide additional protection for all occupants, while Safety Connect offers emergency communication capabilities.

This well-appointed luxury SUV represents a mature platform designed for owners who value reliability, capability, and thoughtful amenities. The combination of genuine four-wheel drive functionality and premium interior features creates a vehicle suited for weekend adventures or daily professional demands. We invite you to experience the commanding driving position, responsive steering, and composed ride quality that define the Lexus GX ownership experience.

A low tire pressure warning system and emergency communication system round out the protective features designed to keep occupants secure.

The split-folding rear seat expands cargo versatility, and the all-weather floor liners with cargo tray protect interior surfaces during active use. The 18-inch aluminum wheels maintain a refined appearance while providing dependable traction. Driver-focused technologies including the Heads-Up Display, lane keeping assist, and blind spot monitoring contribute to confident operation in any environment.

The parking assistance features—including the 360-degree camera system and Park Assist—simplify maneuvering in tight spaces despite the vehicle's substantial footprint.

This Range Rover combines the capability expected of its nameplate with the refinement and attention to detail that defines the Autobiography designation, making it an excellent choice for those seeking a luxury SUV that delivers on both presence and substance. Discover the 2022 Kia Telluride SX, a three-row SUV that delivers the space and capability your family needs without compromise.

- 3.8L V6 engine with 8-speed automatic transmission
- Three-row seating with split-folding rear seats and reclining third row
- Heated and ventilated front bucket seats with leather trim
- Power moonroof and power liftgate
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration
- Navigation system with 10-speaker harman/kardon audio
- Dual front zone automatic climate control with rear air conditioning
- Remote keyless entry with smart key and push button start
- 20-inch black alloy wheels
- Four-wheel independent suspension with electronic stability control
- Multiple airbags including knee and overhead protection
- Emergency communication system with 911 Connect
- All-weather capability with rear window defroster and wiper

This Telluride SX comes equipped with practical conveniences designed for daily living. The power driver seat with memory settings adjusts to your preferences, while the leather steering wheel and shift knob add refinement to the cabin. Heated door mirrors and fully automatic headlights with delay-off function enhance visibility and safety. The roof rack rails provide storage versatility, and the hybrid cargo net keeps your belongings secure.

Your driving experience is enhanced by thoughtful technology throughout the vehicle. Speed-sensing steering adapts to your driving conditions, while tilt and telescoping steering wheel adjustment ensures comfort for all drivers. The auto-dimming rear-view mirror reduces glare, and HomeLink garage door integration keeps your routines seamless. Steering wheel-mounted audio controls let you manage your entertainment without taking your hands off the wheel.

The SX trim reflects Kia's commitment to your satisfaction. Forward-thinking features like the 911 Connect emergency communication system provide peace of mind for you and your passengers. The split-folding rear seat and reclining third row give you flexibility to configure the cabin for passengers or cargo as your needs change.

On the road, this Telluride delivers 20 city MPG and 26 highway MPG, providing respectable fuel economy for a vehicle of this size and capability. The four-wheel disc brakes with ABS and comprehensive traction control systems keep you confident during your commute or weekend adventures.

This is a well-maintained vehicle ready to become part of your family's routine. We invite you to visit our showroom to experience the Telluride SX in person and take it for a test drive.

This 2022 Jeep Wrangler Unlimited Willys in striking Hydro Blue Pearlcoat represents the ideal combination of capability and refinement for those seeking authentic off-road performance with modern conveniences.

- TECHNOLOGY GROUP with Auto Temperature Control Air Conditioning and SiriusXM Satellite Radio
- Uconnect 4 Infotainment System with 7" Display and Apple CarPlay/Android Auto
- XTREME RECON 35" TIRE PACKAGE with 35" Tires and Beadlock Capable Wheels
- Dana M210 Wide HD Tube Front Axle and Dana M220 Wide Rear Axle
- Anti-Lock 4-Wheel Disc Performance Brakes with 4.56 Rear Axle Ratio
- BLACK 3-PIECE HARD TOP with MOPAR Sunrider for Hardtop
- Corning Gorilla Glass Windshield
- LED Premium Reflector Headlamps and Front LED Fog Lamps
- ParkView Rear Back-Up Camera
- 2-Door Passive Entry with Front Door Locks
- 7.0" TFT Color Cluster Display
- Power Steering with Steering Wheel Mounted Audio Controls
- Electronic Stability Control and Traction Control
- Split Folding Rear Seat with Cloth Low-Back Bucket Seats
- Front Center Armrest with Storage

This vehicle delivers proven performance through its 3.6L V6 engine paired with an 8-Speed Automatic transmission and 4WD capability, achieving 19 city and 24 highway MPG. The Willys trim level provides purposeful engineering that meets both daily driving needs and weekend adventures with confidence.

The Xtreme Recon 35" Tire Package distinguishes this Wrangler as a serious choice for those who demand enhanced traction and capability. Heavy-duty axles, injection-molded black rear bumper, wheel flare extensions, and MOPAR reinforcement components demonstrate the attention to detail built into this package. The setup includes a 4.56 rear axle ratio and 35" tire suspension tuned for demanding terrain.

Comfort and connectivity are assured through the Technology Group, featuring automatic climate control, SiriusXM Satellite Radio with service included, and air filtering for cabin freshness. The Uconnect 4 system with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration keeps you connected to what matters. The 7.0" TFT color display cluster provides critical information at a glance.

Safety features on this Unlimited Willys include dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, integrated roll-over protection, anti-lock 4-wheel disc brakes, and electronic stability control. The ParkView rear back-up camera assists during reversing, while the comprehensive SiriusXM Guardian emergency communication system provides added peace of mind.

This 2022 Jeep Grand Cherokee L Summit in Black delivers impressive capability with a HEMI 5.7L V8 engine paired to an 8-speed automatic transmission and 4WD, achieving 14 city and 22 highway MPG.

- HEMI 5.7L V8 Multi Displacement VVT Engine
- 8-Speed Automatic Transmission with 4WD
- Uconnect 5 Navigation with 10.1" Display
- Heads-Up Display
- Night Vision with Pedestrian-Animal Detection
- Panoramic Power Moonroof
- Premium Nappa Leather and Palermo Leather Seats
- Heated and Ventilated Front Seats
- Heated Rear Seats with Ventilation
- 19-Speaker High Performance Audio System with 950 Watt Amplifier
- Wireless Charging Pad
- Three-Row Seating with Power Fold Seatbacks
- Auto-Dimming Rearview Mirror with Interior Rear-Facing Camera
- MOPAR Bright Side Steps
- Advanced Safety Features Including Multiple Airbags and Electronic Stability Control

The Summit Reserve package elevates this Grand Cherokee L with premium materials throughout the cabin. Palermo leather adorns the seats and door panels, while a deluxe headliner and genuine wood inserts create an upscale environment. The driver and front passenger enjoy power-adjustable, heated, and ventilated seats with memory functions, ensuring personalized comfort on every drive.

Technology capabilities are comprehensive. The Uconnect 5 navigation system displays information on a 10.1-inch touchscreen, while the heads-up display projects key data onto the windshield for convenience. Night vision with pedestrian and animal detection enhances awareness in low-light conditions. Wireless charging keeps compatible devices powered, and the interior rear-facing camera provides additional perspective when needed.

Entertainment comes through a 19-speaker audio system delivering 950 watts of power, complemented by SiriusXM satellite radio with the 360L package. Steering wheel mounted controls and radio data system integration make accessing your favorite content straightforward while keeping your attention on the road.

Versatility defines the Grand Cherokee L's layout. Three rows of seating accommodate passengers comfortably, with power fold seatbacks in the second row for flexible cargo management. The power liftgate opens with the push of a button, making loading and unloading effortless. Rear window shades provide climate control and privacy for back-seat passengers.

Advanced safety systems work together to protect you and your passengers. Four-wheel independent suspension adapts to road conditions, while electronic stability control and traction control maintain stability. Anti-whiplash front head restraints, dual front impact airbags, and multiple side-impact airbags surround you with protection. Emergency communication systems provide additional peace of mind during unexpected situations.

This 2022 Jeep Grand Cherokee L Summit represents a sophisticated choice for those seeking capability, luxury, and technology in a three-row midsize SUV format. We invite you to schedule a test drive and experience the commanding presence and refined interior firsthand.

The electronic stability control and traction control systems work together to maintain grip and stability. A rearview parking camera adds an extra layer of awareness when backing up.

Interior appointments reflect thoughtful design with leather shift knob, HomeLink garage door transmitter, and comprehensive storage including driver and passenger door bins. The auto-dimming rear-view mirror reduces glare, while the trip computer and tachometer provide useful vehicle information at a glance.

This 2022 Hyundai Palisade Calligraphy in Black represents a sophisticated choice for families seeking a premium three-row vehicle that balances luxury appointments with practical functionality.

- Harman/Kardon® premium audio system with 12 speakers
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration
- Navigation system with real-time routing
- Power moonroof for enhanced open-air comfort

- Heated and ventilated front bucket seats

- Heated steering wheel

- Auto-leveling suspension for smooth ride quality

- 20-inch Calligraphy exclusive alloy wheels

The Calligraphy trim emphasizes comfort and refinement with its premium Nappa leather seating surfaces, heated and ventilated front seats, and heated rear seating that accommodates all passengers. The three-row layout provides flexibility for families, with a reclining third row and split-folding rear seat configuration that adapts to your cargo needs.

Technology integration is seamless with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto connectivity, complemented by the Harman/Kardon® audio system featuring 12 speakers and SiriusXM satellite radio. The navigation system supports your travels with real-time routing, while the heads-up display keeps essential information visible without distraction.

Handling and safety are priorities in this design. The four-wheel independent suspension paired with auto-leveling technology maintains composure on varied terrain, while electronic stability control and traction management systems work to enhance driver confidence. Speed-sensing steering adjusts responsiveness based on driving conditions.

The V6 engine with eight-speed automatic transmission and all-wheel drive delivers capable performance, achieving 19 mpg in city driving and 24 mpg on the highway. The all-wheel drive system provides traction across different weather and road conditions.

Convenience features throughout the cabin include automatic temperature control with dual front and rear zones, a power moonroof, power-adjustable seats with memory functions, and intelligent lighting with auto high-beam functionality. The cargo package equips you with a cargo tray, net, and cover to organize your transport needs efficiently.

This Palisade Calligraphy combines the practicality of family transportation with the comfort expectations of the premium segment. We invite you to examine this vehicle in our showroom and discover how its capabilities align with your driving requirements.

The SiriusXM satellite radio system with 360L provides entertainment options, and the garage door transmitter lets you access your home without fumbling for remotes.

The exterior reflects Audi's commitment to purposeful design. The sport exhaust tips announce the vehicle's capabilities, while the 20-inch 10-spoke-star design wheels fill the wheel arches with style. The panoramic sunroof floods the cabin with natural light, and the privacy trunk cover maintains your security and interior privacy.

Every detail contributes to ownership satisfaction. The power liftgate, all-weather floor mats, and cargo mat enhance practicality, while the leatherette-covered center console and door armrests add refinement to the interior. This SQ5 Premium Plus quattro is ready to serve as your reliable daily driver and weekend companion. We invite you to visit and experience this vehicle firsthand.

The 2023 Volvo XC90 B6 Plus 7-Seater combines Scandinavian design excellence with practical family functionality, offering a refined driving experience for those who demand both capability and sophistication.

- 21" 5 V-Spoke Black Diamond Cut Alloy Wheels
- All-Season Tires (275/40R21)
- Harman/Kardon Premium Sound with 600-watt amplifier
- Heated Front Bucket Seats with Memory positioning
- Front and Rear Dual Zone Automatic Temperature Control
- Power Moonroof
- Navigation System with Apple CarPlay
- Emergency Communication System (Volvo Cars App with 4 Year Subscription)
- Leather Upholstery with Genuine Wood Dashboard and Door Panels
- Heated Steering Wheel
- Luggage Cover and Cargo Tray
- Protection Package Premier (includes Rubber Floor Mats, Bumper Cover, First Aid Kit, Wheel Locks)
- Exterior Rear Parking Camera
- Integrated Rear Child Seats in Third Row
- Split Folding Rear Seat with 7-Passenger configuration

This white XC90 seats up to seven passengers comfortably, with heated front and rear seats ensuring comfort during cooler months. The versatile interior layout includes integrated rear child seats and a split folding rear seat, providing flexibility for families and their cargo needs. Three rows of seating allow you to accommodate passengers while maintaining access to a generous cargo area, making this vehicle ideal for active households.

The 2.0L turbocharged four-cylinder engine with automatic transmission and all-wheel drive delivers balanced performance with an estimated 20 MPG city and 26 MPG highway. The power steering, four-wheel independent suspension, and speed-sensing steering contribute to confident handling and responsive control. Electronic Stability Control and traction control work together with ABS brakes to enhance safety during varied driving conditions.

The Harman/Kardon Premium Sound system with a 600-watt amplifier brings quality audio into every drive, complemented by steering wheel-mounted controls for convenience. The navigation system and Apple CarPlay integration keep you connected and informed, while SiriusXM radio provides entertainment options throughout your journey. Interior amenities include a power driver seat with memory settings, a heated steering wheel, and ambient lighting throughout the cabin.

Safety is a priority in this model, featuring dual front and side impact airbags, knee airbags, and overhead airbags for comprehensive protection. The emergency communication system provides added peace of mind with direct connection to Volvo Cars support. Anti-whiplash front head restraints, low tire pressure warning, and occupant sensing airbags demonstrate the vehicle's commitment to passenger security.

The exterior presents a clean, sophisticated appearance with body-color bumpers, heated power door mirrors with turn signal indicators, and auto-dimming rear-view capability. Fully automatic headlights with delay-off function, front fog lights, and rear fog lights ensure visibility in various conditions. The spoiler and distinctive 21-inch black diamond cut alloy wheels enhance the premium aesthetic while the luggage cover protects cargo from view.

With approximately 37,278 miles, this XC90 B6 Plus remains a capable, well-appointed family vehicle ready to serve your transportation needs for years to come.

This 2023 Acura MDX Advance SH-AWD represents a well-maintained three-row luxury SUV designed for families who value comfort, capability, and refinement.

- Acura Navigation System with 3D View
- 20" Aluminum Alloy Wheels
- ELS Studio 3D Premium Audio System with 16 Speakers
- SiriusXM Radio with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto
- Heated and Ventilated Front Sport Seats
- Heated Rear Seats

The MDX comes equipped with a 3.5L V6 engine paired with a 10-speed automatic transmission and all-wheel drive, delivering balanced performance with an EPA rating of 19 city and 25 highway MPG. This particular example has been carefully inspected through Acura's comprehensive multi-point check process and carries a clean Carfax history, coming to us as a single-owner vehicle from a local trade.

Inside the cabin, you'll find premium Milano leather trimmed seating throughout, with power-adjustable front seats featuring heating and ventilation to suit your preferences. The rear seats also offer heating capability, and the split-folding design provides flexibility for cargo needs. - 22" Premium Black-Painted Aluminum Wheels
- Voice-Activated Touch-Screen Navigation System with pinch-to-zoom capability
- 360-Degree Camera with Split View
- Adaptive Cruise Control with stop-and-go
- Lane-Keeping System with lane-keeping assist and alert
- Pre-Collision Assist with pedestrian detection and forward collision warning
- Enhanced Active Park Assist System with parallel and perpendicular parking
- Gloss Black Power Deployable Running Boards
- Heated and Cooled Leather Front Bucket Seats
- Heavy-Duty Trailer Tow Package with Integrated Trailer Brake Controller and Pro Trailer Backup Assist

Advanced driver assistance features work seamlessly to enhance safety and reduce fatigue. Adaptive cruise control with stop-and-go functionality adapts to traffic flow, while the lane-keeping system helps maintain your intended path. Pre-collision assist with pedestrian detection adds another layer of protection for you and those around you.

For those who tow, the heavy-duty trailer tow package equips this Expedition with an integrated trailer brake controller, pro trailer backup assist, and a heavy-duty engine radiator to handle serious loads. The electronic limited slip differential and 3.73 axle ratio optimize towing performance and stability.

This 2019 Expedition Limited offers the space, capability, and technology expected from a modern full-size SUV. We invite you to visit our showroom to experience its commanding presence and refined interior firsthand.

This 2018 Chevrolet Tahoe Premier delivers the commanding presence and three-row capability you need for family adventures and everyday versatility.

- EcoTec3 6.2L V8 engine with 10-speed automatic transmission
- RST 6.2L Performance Edition with sport calibration
- 4WD with 2-speed active transfer case
- 22" Gloss Black aluminum wheels with custom silver inserts
- Power sunroof
- Rear seat Blu-Ray/DVD entertainment system
- Chevrolet MyLink navigation and premium audio system
- Heated and ventilated front seats with memory settings
- Heated second row seats and power-adjustable pedals
- Front and rear park assist with rear camera
- Lane Keep Assist with Lane Departure Warning
- Forward Collision Alert and Low Speed Forward Automatic Braking
- Adaptive suspension with Magnetic Ride Control
- Hands-free power liftgate
- SiriusXM satellite radio with NavTraffic service

This Premier model arrives finished in silver with distinguished RST styling cues, including the unique Gloss Black Sport grille, black body-color door handles, black mirror caps, and distinctive black bowtie badging. The aggressive 22-inch wheels with custom accents underscore the performance-focused character of this full-size SUV. Inside, you'll find perforated leather-appointed seating, power-reclining front buckets, and the capability to seat up to eight passengers across three rows.

The interior emphasizes comfort and convenience with an enhanced 8-inch driver information center, heated steering wheel, wireless charging, and integrated Apple CarPlay and Android Auto connectivity. Dual-zone automatic temperature control maintains comfort for front passengers, while rear air conditioning and heated second-row seats ensure all passengers travel in luxury. An OnStar Basic Plan provides five years of connected vehicle services and emergency support.

Performance meets practicality with the EcoTec3 V8 delivering 14 city and 22 highway MPG. The 4WD system includes a 2-speed active transfer case designed to adapt to various road conditions, while high-capacity air cleaner and 170-amp alternator support sustained power delivery. Magnetic Ride Control suspension technology helps balance the driving experience between comfort and handling.

Safety is integrated throughout, with dual front and side impact airbags, overhead airbags, four-wheel antilock disc brakes, electronic stability control, traction control, and blind zone monitoring. Rear cross-traffic alert, forward collision alert, and lane-change alert systems provide additional confidence during daily driving.

The Tahoe Premier combines three-row seating efficiency with premium appointment levels designed for those who refuse to compromise between capability and comfort. This is an SUV built to handle whatever you need, whenever you need it.

- LED Lighting Group with daytime running lamps, front fog lamps, LED reflector headlamps, and LED taillamps
- 8.4" Uconnect 4C Navigation system with touchscreen display
- Alpine Premium Audio System with HD Radio and SiriusXM
- Cold Weather Group featuring heated steering wheel and heated front seats
- Blind Spot and Cross Path Detection
- ParkSense Rear Park Assist System with backup camera
- Trailer Tow and HD Electrical Group with Class II receiver hitch

Its body-color fender flares and matching finish create a cohesive, refined appearance while preparing you for genuine trail work.

Under the hood, a 3.6-liter V6 engine paired with an eight-speed automatic transmission delivers responsive power for both highway driving and off-road situations. The Rubicon trim includes a robust 4.10 rear axle ratio specifically engineered for low-speed torque and traction optimization. At 18 miles per gallon in the city and 22 on the highway, you'll find reasonable efficiency for this class of vehicle.

The technology suite elevates everyday driving through the Uconnect system, which integrates navigation, smartphone connectivity through Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, and voice controls accessible from the leather-wrapped steering wheel. SiriusXM satellite radio with traffic and travel link services keeps you informed during longer journeys. The 4G LTE hotspot transforms your vehicle into a mobile office or entertainment hub.

Safety features including blind spot detection, cross path detection, and rear park assist combine with standard airbags and electronic stability control to provide comprehensive protection. The heated steering wheel and seats ensure comfort through colder months, while the auxiliary battery system supports the vehicle's electrical demands during extended off-road excursions.

This Wrangler Unlimited Rubicon merges genuine capability with the daily conveniences modern owners expect, delivering a vehicle that performs equally well on city streets and challenging terrain.

        • Lane departure prevention - Keep it between the lines. It only takes a moment of inattention for your vehicle to drift.         • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped.
